notes.title: Achievements
notes.notes:
[p]Hi there! I have a small update for you all -- achievements! Originally I didn't think people would care about achievements, but quite a few of you asked for them so I decided to add some to the game.

There are 7 achievements, all of which require you to visit the cemetery on certain days. I hope these will encourage you to visit the cemetery throughout the year and see how the cemetery changes with the seasons!
[/p][p]My goal was to get these out yesterday so that you could all get the father's day achievement, but unfortunately I pushed this update pretty late in the day. However I did test these achievements with time travelling and they still work, if you'd like to change the date on your computer and play the game you'll be able to unlock yesterday's achievement.  [/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for your patience. I hope you enjoy these new achievements![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45584522/d609e83c8b58a87a26f315c248acad17ca49c74e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Here's a hint for the hidden achievement: it's a reference to [i]A Mortician's Tale[/i]. I worked on Seasonala with most of the same people I worked with on [i]A Mortician's Tale[/i] and the game is very near and dear to our hearts. There's a lil easter egg in the game and you'll get an achievement if you play the game on [i][b]a certain day related to it.[/b][/i][/p]

notes.title: Seasonala Cemetery is OUT NOW
notes.notes: [p]Hello! We're so excited to announce that our game Seasonala Cemetery is available now, completely free for both Windows and Mac![/p][p][/p][p]Seasonala Cemetery started as a small project I prototyped in the early days of the COVID-19 pandemic. I found a lot of solace going for walks through cemeteries (namely Mount Pleasant Cemetery and Toronto Necropolis) and it was cathartic seeing how places we often associate with death could breathe with so much life. I wanted to recreate that experience in game-form, hoping that maybe this game could help someone find solace during times of their own grief and anxiety.[/p][p][/p][p]I worked with most of the same people I worked with on A Mortician's Tale, plus a few new additions, who all helped me bring this little game about death to life. Seasonala Cemetery is the product of all of us, and I hope you all enjoy playing it and visiting the cemetery throughout the seasons.  Be sure to also check out the [url="https://hlnhrn.bandcamp.com/album/seasonala-cemetery"]original soundtrack by halina heron[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Love from,[/p][p]the Seasonala Cemetery team[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45584522/2566b5db49cd41e59126629a76bad99ec34acdd0.jpg"][/img][/p]
